title: Ownership in function signatures
description:
The starter does not compile: the tests keep using values after passing them to these functions, which moves them. Change the **signatures** (and bodies) so each function borrows when it only needs to read, and takes ownership only when it really keeps or changes the value:

```rust
fn report(names: ...) -> String               // "3 names: Ada, Grace, Linus"; "no names" when empty
fn longest(a: ..., b: ...) -> String          // a copy of the longer text (the first on a tie)
fn shout(text: String) -> String              // takes ownership: upper-cases the text in place and adds "!"
fn add_suffix(names: ..., suffix: &str)       // appends suffix to every name in the vector, in place
```

Read the tests to see how each function is called.
hints: A function that only reads a list of strings should take `&[String]` (it then accepts `&Vec<String>`, slices and `&[]`); one that only reads text should take `&str`.
`fn shout(mut text: String)` owns its parameter, so it may change it in place and hand it back; `add_suffix` needs `&mut Vec<String>` and `iter_mut()`.
